principle: One canonical spatial/project graph, many visual lenses. Lenses change visibility, styling and interaction; they never create separate versions of the building.

lenses.name: Experience
lenses.purpose: Homeowner/decorator view of the finished building.
lenses.default_interaction: inspect visible finishes, furniture and fixtures

lenses.name: Architecture
lenses.purpose: Architectural working view with clean linework and spatial hierarchy.
lenses.default_interaction: select spaces, walls, slabs, openings and dimensions

lenses.name: Build / Assembly
lenses.purpose: Dissect the building into physical construction layers and packages.
lenses.default_interaction: explode wall/roof/floor/system and inspect each layer

lenses.name: Product Twins
lenses.purpose: Show the building as a composition of real or unresolved Product Twins.
lenses.default_interaction: select product, substitute, compare, open Twin inspector

lenses.name: Procurement
lenses.purpose: Visualize quote/order/manufacture/shipping/site state directly on the house.

lenses.name: Systems / MEP
lenses.purpose: Isolate electrical, plumbing, HVAC, pool, solar and controls networks.
lenses.default_interaction: trace connected system and inspect equipment/interfaces

lenses.name: Regulation
lenses.purpose: Expose regulatory evidence and unresolved compliance states spatially.
lenses.default_interaction: inspect rule, evidence, jurisdiction and required reviewer

lenses.name: Performance
lenses.purpose: Show sun, shading, thermal, solar, energy and environmental results on the actual building.
lenses.default_interaction: inspect surface/system performance and compare design alternatives

lenses.name: As-built / Operations
lenses.default_interaction: inspect serial, warranty, manuals, maintenance and replacement options

exploded_product_view.purpose: Temporarily separate the house into product/assembly groups without changing canonical transforms.
